channels.name: npm / Pi package gallery
channels.instructions: The public package is @living-code/pi, exposing themes only. Verify npm organization access and publish the reviewed tarball from an authenticated npm session with npm publish <tgz> --access public --ignore-scripts, or dispatch this port's manual publish-npm workflow using npm trusted publishing (OIDC), with no npm token. The pi-package keyword makes the npm package eligible for gallery discovery. Install after publication with pi install npm:@living-code/pi. Git installation from living-code-theme/pi also works without npm publication.
